description: He wears a long cream textured tunic and lower underlayer with purple-and-gold woven borders at the round neckline, center front, cuffs and hem. A deep plum-purple draped outer layer crosses one shoulder and falls along the side, with broad gold geometric edging and a small purple-centered clasp. A decorated belt has a round purple-red fitting and hanging woven end. Full sleeves cover the arms and brown leather boots show below the hem. The clothing is opaque, flowing and finely made. No headgear, weapon or armor appears. Exact fibers are uncertain; the cream layer looks linen-like and the purple drape dense and softly textured.
